text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite barely having enough stamina to
finish a
mile race and being forced to
run on heavy turf...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl manages to show off
some
world-class running. However...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I see... So that's how it is...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Taiki...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is just another part of destiny, I
suppose...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl returns to the runners'
tunnel
completely unfazed, despite
being completely
soaked through.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Sure did.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We have two options.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We can take on the Prix Maurice de
Gheest sprint
and win a European G1
ahead of Taiki Shuttle...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Or we can compete against Taiki Shuttle
to claim
the honor of being the first to
win a European G1
at the Prix Jacques
Le Marois mile.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Taiki's aptitude for mile races is just as
formidable
as I thought. Luck was on my
side this time, and I
know she's not
invincible...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But that doesn't change how amazing
she is for
being able to overcome any
bad conditions that
come her way.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I think I'm more suited to
sprints.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And rather than today's muddy mess, I'd
prefer a
firm track on a sunny day.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I've realized I'll be better
off running
the Prix Maurice de Gheest.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I should try my luck at winning a
European G1
that's the right distance for
me, and on turf that I
run best on.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that's the best way forward for
me.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I can see it now...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My name, Seeking the Pearl, glorified
forever as
the first Umamusume from
Tracen Academy to
win a European G1...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's my promised future, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our path forward has been determined.
We will
run in the Prix Maurice de
Gheest and win before
Taiki Shuttle
does.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is Seeking the Pearl's—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl suddenly cuts off my
train of
thought with a sharp
exclamation.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Are you sure this is what we should do,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Can we really say following this plan is
enough
after seeing Taiki's enthralling
performance?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My... No, our job is to show off my possibilities to the world. I must max out my potential and overcome impossible obstacles!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Can we really say I achieved such a goal
if I shirk
a race against Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is born with their own destiny.
Fulfilling
your destiny is a wonderful
notion...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But what about the people who've been
dealt a
subpar hand? Are they supposed
to just sit back
and accept that?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: No, I say. Destiny isn't one-size-fits-all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You can carve your own path! And on
that new
road, boundless possibilities
await!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Didn't we make it our mission to spread
that
message to the world?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Farewell, so long! It's time to turn
about-face and
pursue the best future
possible!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I hereby renounce the Prix Maurice de
Gheest!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I know it. I can feel it. Beyond my old
destiny lies
a even brighter future.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
What I seek is the best future possible! I
swear to
carry out my mission to its
completion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a shocking turn of events, Seeking the
Pearl
decides not to run in the Prix
Maurice de Gheest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her course has now changed. What does
the
future hold for her?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is where we veer from destiny's
path. As such,
let's brainstorm our next
steps together.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
From now on, you and I will be the ones
at the
helm of our future.
